"installing a new build loses my progress").

Two changes make upgrades non-destructive:

- Versioned schema + migration plan: open the store through SchemaV1 +
  HanahuacMigrationPlan so an additive/lightweight schema change migrates the
  existing store IN PLACE (progress preserved) instead of throwing. Future
  versions append SchemaVN + a .lightweight stage.

- Non-destructive recovery path: if the container still won't open, the store
  is first copied to a timestamped `…-autorecover` backup under
  ~/Library/Application Support/Hanahuac-backups/ (ProgressBackup), then a
  guaranteed-local container is attempted WITHOUT deleting anything. The store
  is wiped only as a genuine last resort, never silently — the backup is always
  the recovery point. Backups share the recipe's root and 10-dir retention cap.

ProgressBackupTests covers copy-without-deleting-original, fresh-install no-op,
and retention pruning.
